title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: mac > Nakamichi 680ZX > Tascam CD RW5000 > Bias Peak 3.21 on G4 Powerbook > wav > flac
source: Nakamichi  CM300 shotguns  > Technics 686 > Maxell UD XL II

ai_review.summary: High‑energy outdoor set captured on a clean soundboard feed with crisp vocals and tight mix; standout performances of Shakedown Street, Samson and Sugar Magnolia shine despite a slight mid‑range loss in Phil’s bass.
ai_review.review: The show bursts with upbeat, festival‑day enthusiasm – the band rides an infectious groove through Shakedown Street, Samson, China Cat > I Know You Rider, Sugar Magnolia, U.S. Blues, Satisfaction and more. The recording is a soundboard capture that sounds snappy and clear, letting the vocals and extra wah‑wah on Shakedown Street shine, though one reviewer notes the mids of Phil’s bass are buried under heavy sub‑bass.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.8) and overwhelmingly enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality; only a single mid‑range bass complaint, so overall rating is strong.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, snappy mix with excellent vocal presence and tight instrument balance; occasional loss of low‑mid frequencies on Phil's bass noted by one reviewer.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Up‑tempo, festival‑morning slot that maintains high momentum throughout; songs flow smoothly with a joyous, almost jazzy feel.

band_member_comments.Phil: One reviewer notes a huge amount of sub‑bass with Phil’s mids missing, likely due to equipment stress in the hot outdoor conditions.
